mapper.select: SELECT id,category_code,category_name,status,sort_no FROM encyclopedia_category WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id,category_code,category_name,status,sort_no FROM encyclopedia_category WHERE category_code=#{categoryCode} AND status='ENABLED'
mapper.sql: FROM encyclopedia_breed b JOIN encyclopedia_category c ON c.id=b.category_id AND c.status='ENABLED' WHERE b.status='PUBLISHED' AND b.category_id=#{categoryId} AND (LOWER(b.name) LIKE #{keywordPattern} OR LOWER(b.aliases) LIKE #{keywordPattern}) AND JSON_CONTAINS(b.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))
mapper.select: SELECT b.id,b.category_id,b.name,b.aliases,b.tags,b.summary,b.cover_url,b.body_type,b.facts,b.radar, b.description_html,b.care_advice_html,b.health_tips_html,b.status,b.sort_no, c.category_code,c.category_name FROM encyclopedia_breed b JOIN encyclopedia_category c ON c.id=b.category_id AND c.status='ENABLED' WHERE b.id=#{breedId} AND b.status='PUBLISHED'
